root_cause: Pikaday adds a global keydown listener that handles ArrowLeft/Right/Up/Down to adjust the date whenever the picker is visible, preventing the default caret movement in other text fields.
repair_strategy: Modify pikaday.js _onKeyChange to only process arrow key navigation when the associated input field (opts.field) is the active element, preserving date picker keyboard navigation when the field has focus while allowing normal text editing elsewhere.
expected_accessibility_effect: ArrowLeft and ArrowRight will now move the caret in any text field, enabling users to correct text. Date picker arrow key navigation remains functional when the delivery-date input is focused.
functional_risks: If the user clicks inside the calendar container and the input loses focus, arrow keys will no longer navigate the calendar until the input is refocused.
verification_requirements: Verify that ArrowLeft in the #notes input moves the caret left and allows inserting a space between 'Gate' and '4'.
Verify that ArrowLeft in the #delivery-date input still decrements the selected date.
Verify that Enter and Esc keys still close the picker and blur the field when appropriate.
Verify that the date picker continues to open and display correctly.
